summary: Make one verified Google login establish one canonical EKODI Person and ecosystem-wide FREE membership across all registered user services, while preserving site-local return context and strictly preventing paid, tenant/workspace, site-admin or platform-admin privilege propagation.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly confirmed the one-login/common-FREE model and then instructed EKODI on 2026-09-29 to set it as a forced execution rule.
implementation: operational standard in docs/AUTH-CENTER.md and CONSTITUTION.md
mandatoryRules: first verified Google sign-in creates or resolves one canonical EKODI Person and establishes ecosystem-wide FREE
all current and future registry user services inherit the common FREE entitlement
a valid central session is reused and reauthentication occurs only when session or security policy requires it
authentication returns to the exact trusted initiating site and path; cross-service and generic My EKODI fallback are forbidden
common FREE never grants paid features, tenant/workspace membership, site-admin authority or platform-admin authority
site-admin authority never propagates to another site without an explicit target-site membership/capability grant
rollback: Revert Constitution v1.26.1 enforcement metadata, policy assertions and validators through the guarded C2 path to v1.26.0 if the amendment itself causes a regression. Preserve the previously working one-login FREE runtime and privilege-separation behavior during rollback; do not introduce repeated signup, cross-site admin propagation or generic cross-service login fallback.
